theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the only theme combining a top-3 rank with genuinely healthy trend internals: durability_bar 0.8 (strongest in the set), breadth 0.9 (cohesive), hurst_tag 'trend' (persistent, not mixed/mean-revert), and crowding_z 0.24 (not crowded). Unlike the Banks leader, this is the one name where the rank is corroborated by the trend-gate leg rather than contradicted by it. The lean is a durability judgement, not a momentum forecast: a theme this trend-healthy and uncrowded is where a vol-aware allocator wants to stay as long as the gate holds.
theses.dissent: Energy is commodity-exposed and headline-driven; the macro_narrative backdrop shows ai_tech as dominant with unscheduled_share 1.0, meaning a surprise macro/policy shock could hit cyclical energy names hardest regardless of trend health. The rank itself (relative momentum) has ~0 rank-IC on clean sectors, so the second-place position carries no predictive weight on its own.
